name: Path of the Beast
description: A barbarian subclass that adds the Beast tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Form of the Beast
grants.description: When you enter Rage, manifest a Bite, Claws, or Tail natural weapon until the Rage ends. It uses Strength, counts as a simple melee weapon, and gains the option's healing, extra-attack, or defensive benefit.

grants.name: Bestial Soul
grants.description: Your Form of the Beast weapons count as magical. After a rest, choose a swimming adaptation, a climbing adaptation, or an enhanced jump until your next rest.

grants.name: Infectious Fury
grants.description: Once per turn when a Form of the Beast weapon hits, force a Wisdom save. On a failure, the target either takes 2d12 Psychic damage or uses its Reaction to attack a creature you choose. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Call the Hunt
grants.description: When you enter Rage, empower willing creatures nearby. You gain temporary Hit Points for each participant, and each empowered ally can add 1d6 damage to one hit per turn while your Rage lasts. Once per Long Rest.
